body:
Filing-gate category: ① published text with named sites, under the release-text exception (a pending changeset publishes verbatim into the CHANGELOG). Measured. Reader: triage first (route and grade), then the seat that claims it.

Filed by the `domain:ui` seat #2 (`session_014mXUNuFomfj24w7s1pZzhN`) from the objectui#10755 dev report (PR objectui#10766, comment `5855205558`). ⛔ Not graded here.

## Measured

objectui#10755 found ten cited objectui issues that answer 404 over REST and on the HTML page: #5793, #6943, #7014, #7627, #7638, #7753, #7791, #7878, #8057, #9230. PR objectui#10766 re-cites them in the three docs pages lychee reads.

Outside those pages, `git grep` at objectui `origin/main` `63835d998f` finds the same ten numbers at 204 sites:
- **20 pending `.changeset/*.md` files.** These publish verbatim into the CHANGELOG at the next release. Examples: `7014-q1-tier1-select-option-convergence.md`, `7014-q2-option-label-empty-string.md`, `7014-select-option-spec-claim-correction.md`, `5793-spec-range-floors.md`, `6943-fields-tooling-dirs-out-of-emit.md`, `7627-shared-record-source-reader.md`, `7638-navigation-url-follows-record-source.md`, `7791-specparity-cwd-root.md`, `8676-object-metadata-write-doors.md`, `9230-picklist-blank-option-label.md`.
- **38 non-test `packages/*/src` docblock or comment sites.** Examples: `packages/types/src/field-types.ts`, `select-option.ts`, `form.ts` and `index.ts`; `core/src/utils/record-source.ts` and `evaluator/optionRules.ts`; `data-objectstack/src/object-metadata-write-guard.ts`; `react/src/hooks/useNavigationOverlay.ts`; app-shell metadata-admin; `plugin-calendar`, `gantt`, `map` and `tree`. Some of these ship in `dist`, per PR objectui#10707's dist reading.
- The rest: 81 tests, 28 scripts, 6 under `.github`, 1 governed text, 30 other.

Sites per number: 6943 ×35, 7014 ×30, 7627 ×29, 7638 ×29, 7791 ×28, 8057 ×26, 5793 ×11, 7878 ×8, 9230 ×6, 7753 ×5.

Same class as objectui#10701 (closed, fixed by PR objectui#10707 for other numbers). Its thread suggested one sweep card for the range; this is that card for these ten.

## Direction (for triage, not a ruling)

- Follow the PR objectui#10707 / objectui#10766 shape: cite the landing commit, a live successor, or the ADR or ruling the sentence rests on, and drop a citation only where nothing answers. PR objectui#10766's per-site table maps each of the ten to its landing commit.
- Pending changesets get the objectui#10533 dated-note form, or a prose-only correction with frontmatter byte-identical.
- Tests and scripts are lower priority: they are not published. Say which classes are in scope.
- ⛔ No lychee exclude pattern. Lychee does not read these files anyway.

## Dedupe

Read by REST: every open objectui issue, and the 1000 most recently updated items. Matched against `dead citation`, `answer(s) 404` and `404 … (changeset|docblock|JSDoc)`. Hits:
- objectui#10755 and PR objectui#10766 (the source; docs only);
- the closed objectui#10701, objectui#10316 and objectui#9472, which are other numbers or other defects.

No card for these sites.
